_comment: Hand-rolled Code Connect. Figma's real Code Connect needs an Organization or Enterprise plan; this repo's Figma account is on Professional. This file does the same job — resolving a Figma node to the source file that implements it — and it lives in git where it can be reviewed in a diff. app/__tests__/figma-contract.test.ts asserts every `source` below still exists, so the map cannot quietly rot.

_pages.Foundations: 0:1. Token swatches and the round-trip contract, restated inside the file so it travels with the design.
_pages.Components: 2:20. Main components. Each carries a description naming its source file.
_pages.Screens — Landing: 2:21. The assembled public landing route at two breakpoints.
_pages.Screens — Research: 26:2. The /research index and both field notes, desktop only.

_scope.covered: Two public surfaces. (1) The landing route — app/app/page.tsx → LandingPage → LandingNav + LandingHero, at both breakpoints. (2) The research route — app/app/research/page.tsx and both field notes under it, desktop only.
_scope.notCovered: app/components/landing/landing-sections.tsx, order-scroll-story.tsx and landing-request-access.tsx are NOT rendered by any route right now, and are left out of Figma deliberately — pushing dead components would invite design work on surfaces that do not ship. The research pages are desktop-only in Figma; their sub-lg layout (cast rail goes grid-cols-3, article rows collapse to a 3-column grid, the request-access rail drops below the body) is not drawn.
_scope.codeOnly: Scroll behaviour, the seeded 60-star field, the CSS order-meteors, the nav scroll-to-solid transition, and the looping hero .webm. Figma holds the poster still. Describe changes to these in an annotation; do not try to redraw them.

components.note: Component set, 8 variants. Variant=Primary → cva variant "default"; Variant=Glass → variant "glass". The Size axis maps to the responsive classes at each call site, NOT to the cva `size` prop: Default = nav CTA at sm+, Large = hero CTA at sm+, Mobile Nav / Mobile Hero = the below-sm forms.
Component set. Layout=Row is the lg: rail (34px chip, 14px label); Layout=Stack is the mobile grid-cols-3 form (28px chip, 11px label). Step copy comes from landingHero.proofSteps in content.ts.
landingHero.proofStats tile. Label Geist Mono 10 uppercase; value Geist SemiBold 18.
Vector built from the two paths inlined in the component (viewBox 345 345 320 320). Upstream truth is omega-docs/03-brand/assets/logo/omega-mark-glyph.svg — change it there first.

Component set, 5 variants (Taker, Maker, Omega, Tempo, Proof). Line icons on a 64 unit grid, 1.5 stroke. Adding a sixth means adding it to marketInstrumentNames in code first — the set is closed brand geometry, not an icon library.

Field=Input maps to the cva default variant. Field=Textarea is NOT this component in code — it is the inline <textarea> in request-access-form.tsx, drawn here with the same skin. The glass input variant exists in code but no research surface uses it, so it is not drawn.
One <li> of the article list. Content is data, not layers — it comes from researchPosts in research-content.ts.

frames.note: 1440×900, the lg breakpoint. Route entry is app/app/page.tsx. See _roundTrips['2026-08-18'] for what landed from the design pass and what was rejected.

390×844. Not a separate implementation — the differences are Tailwind responsive prefixes inside landing-nav.tsx and landing-hero.tsx. See _roundTrips['2026-08-18'] for what landed from the design pass and what was rejected.
Drawn in its transparent state. Past 24px of scroll it takes a 1px --border bottom, an 80% --background wash, a 12px backdrop blur, and padding-block goes 18 → 12.
Headline/eyebrow/supporting strings are NOT authored in Figma — they come from landingHero in app/components/landing/content.ts. Edit copy there, or say so in an annotation.
The <aside>. Material is the .glass utility in app/app/styles/materials.css, not a per-layer effect.
Poster still of public/landing/blackhole/omega-blackhole-hero-desktop.webm. The starfield and order meteors are CSS and are not represented.
Route entry is app/app/research/page.tsx. Known code issue recorded on the Identity column annotation: the 72px headline overflows its 32fr track by ~21px at viewports >=1200px.
Copy lives in this page file directly; the shell is research-article.tsx. No rail, so the body is a single column.
Copy and the rail prop live in this page file; the shell is research-article.tsx.
The nav + header + [body, optional rail] grid both field notes share. Editing the shell in one frame means editing it in both.
Drawn resting. Focus, error, submitting and success states are code. Validation copy lives in app/lib/landing/request-access.ts; the panel material is .panel in app/app/styles/materials.css.

copy.note: Landing strings live in app/components/landing/content.ts. Research index strings live in app/components/research/research-content.ts. Both field notes carry their own copy inline in their page.tsx. Text edited in Figma is a request, not a source.

landed: Headline → 'Private orderbook for stablecoins.'; new two-sentence supporting paragraph.
Nav CTA → 'Fund account' at every breakpoint; the below-sm collapse to 'Fund' is gone.
Panel header → 'Omega Markets Status' (Geist Mono Medium 13/14, normal case), replacing the uppercase mono-11 'DARK BOOK' label. Badge → 'Live alpha testnet'.
NEW live-metrics row above the mechanism steps: 'Batch number - testnet' and 'Volume (30d) - testnet', both '###'. The placeholder is deliberate until the testnet feed is wired.
Step 02 → 'Orders match'; first proof stat label → 'Flow'.
Hero copy is top-aligned instead of bottom-pinned; copy measure capped at 553px and the panel column fixed at 519px at lg.
Hero backdrop video dropped from 0.9 to 0.5 opacity.

rejected.what: The desktop panel arrived wrapped in a container named 'Light' (node 16:2226): 519x470 fixed, 10px radius on the top corners only, a 1px black border on left/right/top, no backdrop blur.
rejected.why: It referenced --pro/radius/radius and --border-width/w-100, which are not Omega tokens, and a black border on a near-black surface renders invisible. Kyle's call: use the Omega branding kit for everything, no other libraries. The panel therefore keeps the .glass material (--radius-2xl, --glass-edge, blur) at both breakpoints.

reconciled.copy: The two frames disagreed on three strings. Desktop was the later edit and won: 'Orders match' over 'Orders net in the book', 'Flow' over 'Pre-trade flow', 'Live alpha testnet' over 'Live alpha'. One string per item, no responsive branching.
reconciled.typo: The drawn paragraph read 'Omega Markets is private price discovery venue' with a double space between sentences. Shipped as 'is a private price discovery venue' with single spacing.
reconciled.drags: Mobile had the CTA row at x=41 while its copy sat at x=20, and the desktop panel overhung the 1240 container by 62px. Treated as drag artifacts and normalised onto the container grid.

landed: Headline → 'Private stablecoin swaps' (no terminal period), reverting the pass-1 'Private orderbook for stablecoins.'
Supporting paragraph back to one sentence; the 'neutral dark book that gives verifiable proofs' sentence added in pass 1 is dropped at both breakpoints.
NEW third CTA 'Launch app' (36:44 hero, 36:46 nav), primary skin, same as the fund CTA. Both point at /trade.

Research index: identity blurb → 'Perspectives on digital assets…'; header intro restyled from 17/19px prose to the mono-11 uppercase kicker and rewritten to 'Notes on stablecoins and FX: the first Omega Markets'; count → 'Total / 02'.
Research index row 01 → 'Connect your corridor - design partner signup.' with a new deck; row 02 deck → 'cross flow and settle atomically'.
Both field notes: eyebrow 'Field note NN' → 'Note NN'.
Private price discovery: new deck (takers fund business rails / makers charge rent); body gains 'fair, verifiable price'.

Design partners: title matches the index row; three of four section headings rewritten ('Start with the business case.', 'We’ll test our shared thesis.', 'Summary - One pair. One clear test.'); four body paragraphs replaced.
Request access rail placeholders → 'Your name', 'Your contact', 'Treasury, trade desk, PSP'.

reconciled.copy: Mobile (10:18) was not updated with desktop and still reads 'Orders net in the book', 'Live alpha', 'Pre-trade flow' and 'Launch App'. Desktop won again, as in pass 1 — one string per item, no responsive branching. The mobile frame needs a redraw.
reconciled.typo: The drawn PPD deck reads 'without leaking cost professional traders' — a dropped preposition. Shipped as 'without leaking cost to professional traders'. 'on the takers immediacy needs' is left verbatim; it may be intentional.
reconciled.placeholders: Figma shows the same placeholder ('Treasury, trade desk, PSP') on both Organization and Primary use case. Read as a paste slip: it is applied to Organization only.
reconciled.strays: A loose 'Headline' text node (32:46) sits on the Screens — Landing canvas at 168,469, outside both frames. Not implemented — it belongs to no frame.
reconciled.staleLayerNames: Design partner section frames still carry pass-1 names ('Start with something real.' 30:54, 'We’ll compare it with what already works.' 30:62) while their heading text reads the new copy. Code follows the text.

rejected.what: Primary use case is drawn as a text input (31:66) with a free-text placeholder.
rejected.why: It is a <select> in code, backed by requestAccessUseCases in app/lib/landing/request-access.ts; the submit schema validates against that enum. Turning it into free text would drop the validation and change the API payload. Left as a select pending a call from Kyle.
